_template: Copy this into data/cobbleraids/raids/<name>.json in a datapack to override or add a raid. Only the rewards block is documented here; everything above it is the minimum a definition needs to load. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the parser and exist only as notes.

spawn._enabled: false keeps this out of natural spawning while you test it with /cobbleraids spawn.

rewards._loot_tables: Rolled for every victor, whatever choice they pick. Any loot table the server has loaded works, including other mods' and your own datapack's. Preview one before using it: /cobbleraids debug loot <table>
rewards._choices: The player picks exactly one. A choice may use items, chance_items, loot_tables, or any mix.

supplies._items: Always granted. 'item' is any registered item id, so another mod's items work as-is: create:brass_ingot, mekanism:steel_ingot, and so on. An item whose mod is not installed is skipped with a server-log warning; the rest of the reward is still granted.

mod_loot._this: A choice that is nothing but loot tables. This is the cheap way to hand out another mod's rewards: you borrow whatever that mod already balanced instead of restating it item by item, and it keeps working when that mod changes its own drops.

rewards._contribution_bonus: Extra rolls earned by damage share, on top of the chosen option. tiers map a minimum contribution percentage to a number of rolls; pool is the weighted table those rolls draw from.
